say:1:1330237001:1.text: You charge forward! Make sure your snowball hits your opponent even though you'll be hit too.
say:1:1330237001:1.source_cn: 当然是冲上去！哪怕被雪球砸到，也要将自己手里的雪球砸向对手。
say:1:1330237001:1.male: You charge forward! Make sure your snowball hits your opponent even though you'll be hit too.
say:1:1330237001:1.female: You charge forward! Make sure your snowball hits your opponent even though you'll be hit too.

say:2:1330237002:1.text: It might not guarantee victory, but you'll definitely lose if you keep dodging!
say:2:1330237002:1.source_cn: 打雪仗冲上去不一定胜利，但只想着躲避一定不会赢！
say:2:1330237002:1.male: It might not guarantee victory, but you'll definitely lose if you keep dodging!
say:2:1330237002:1.female: It might not guarantee victory, but you'll definitely lose if you keep dodging!
